dsd.title: DSD + Lit islands
dsd.intro: Declarative Shadow DOM paints first. vulpine-loader defers the Lit module. Lit hydrates the same shadow tree 1:1.
dsd.interaction_hint: Click the box to load the Lit module and hydrate.
dsd.no_js_note: With JavaScript disabled you still see the stepper UI from Declarative Shadow DOM (non-interactive).
